facts.business: Hathway Cable and Datacom Limited provides broadband internet services and cable television services in India.
key_risks: Product & Technology Risk: Traditional cable customer preferences changing slowly towards non-linear content consumption; rapid technology advancements leading to obsolescence of existing assets.
Competition Risk: Low entry barriers and multiple players in broadband and cable business verticals across geographies.
Awareness Risk: Delay in updating/onboarding Local Cable Operators (LCOs) on latest initiatives negating first mover advantage.
facts.related_party_note: Particulars of investments made are provided in the Standalone Financial Statement. Members may refer to Note 4.18 to the Standalone Financial Statement.
